informal_statement: For every modeled candidate and arbitrary real density parameter, replacement perimeter minus candidate perimeter equals c(1-lambda g(X)).
reason: Equivalent in the declared constructor/section context. At GeometricBridge.lean:124-133, the source contract is `theorem cap_replacement_perimeter_difference : candidate.capReplacementRegion.WeightedPerimeter - candidate.WeightedPerimeter = candidate.capChord * (1 - lam * g candidate.capX)`. The exact identity is P(replacement)-P(candidate)=c*(1-lambda*g(X)), which is division-free and valid for arbitrary real lambda. The main proof's opposite-sign saving lambda*c*(g(X)-1/lambda) is used only when lambda > 1. Thus there is no illicit division at lambda=0 or reversal of the improvement sign.
